# Workspace GitHub token
Load when: reading, setting or removing the workspace GitHub token
Applies to: lpm-access    Source: lpm `workspaceRepositoryVault` (`createWorkspaceRepositoryVault`: get, upsert, revoke), `normalizeGithubRepositoryAccessToken`, `probeGithubRepositoryCredential`, `src/cli/workspaceGithubCredentials.ts`; cards `get_workspace_repository_credential`, `upsert_workspace_repository_credential`, `delete_workspace_repository_credential`
## Summary
- The workspace GitHub token is stored encrypted; no tool ever returns it or a preview of it.
- Set it with the CLI, which reads it from an env var and never echoes it: `lpm workspace-github set --workspace <workspaceId> --expected-revision <n> --token-env <ENV_NAME> --confirm`.
- Every write needs `expectedRevision` = the current `revision`.
- Removing it in LPM does not revoke it at GitHub.
- Only scans with `--credential-source workspace` use it; code indexing, code search, excerpts and commit comparison never do.

## Facts
| Field / value | Meaning | Consequence for the agent |
|---|---|---|
| `get_workspace_repository_credential` → `status` | `active`, `revoked` or `absent` | `absent` → `revision` is 0 |
| `revision` | optimistic-concurrency counter; +1 on every set or remove | read it right before each write |
| `configured`, `validatedAt` | whether a token is stored; when GitHub last accepted it | report both in a review |
| `lpm workspace-github get --workspace <workspaceId>` | CLI read of the same summary | same fields; safe to print |
| token format | 20–8192 characters, no whitespace | invalid → "Workspace, token or expected credential revision is invalid." |
| validation | the token is checked against GitHub before it is stored | rejected → "GitHub credential validation failed" → ask the owner for a new token |
| validation budget | 5 attempts per hour per workspace and per user; failed attempts count | rate-limited → wait one hour |
| `--token-env <ENV_NAME>` | the CLI reads the token from that env var | ask the owner for the variable NAME only |
| `--confirm` | agent-asserted flag on `set` and `remove` | send only after the owner's yes for this exact call |
| `upsert_workspace_repository_credential` | MCP fallback; the token travels as the `token` argument, through the agent's context and transcript | only when no CLI is available AND the owner accepted that exposure; value taken from the env var |
| `delete_workspace_repository_credential` / `lpm workspace-github remove` | sets `status` `revoked`, `revision` + 1; already revoked or absent → summary unchanged | `revoked`/`absent` before → report "nothing stored", no call; else tell the owner to revoke the token at GitHub |
| "Credential changed. Reload the current configuration and retry." | `revision` moved | re-read; if your own earlier call moved it, do not repeat |
| consumers | `lpm workspace-repos scan` / `lpm project-repos scan` with `--credential-source workspace` | other code features need the GitHub App or the link creator's credential → `lpm-code-index` |
| scan error "Workspace GitHub credential unavailable or access denied." | token absent, revoked or without access | read `status`; owner sets a new token |
| who can write | workspace owner or admin with a `full` or `custom` key | members can only read the summary |

## Rules
1. Never ask for, print, log or commit the token; ask for the env var name.
2. Read `revision` immediately before a set or remove and pass it unchanged.
3. Use the CLI so the token never enters the conversation; the MCP upsert only after the owner accepts that the token passes through the agent's context.
4. One validation attempt per owner instruction; a failure goes back to the owner, never into a retry loop.
5. After a remove for a leak, say "Revoke the token at GitHub too; LPM does not."
6. A private-repository indexing or search problem is not fixed by this token → `lpm-code-index`.

## Examples
```text
example: owner: "set the workspace GitHub token, it is in GH_WORKSPACE_TOKEN"
-> get_workspace_repository_credential -> status absent, revision 0
-> lpm workspace-github set --workspace <workspaceId> --expected-revision 0 --token-env GH_WORKSPACE_TOKEN --confirm
-> get_workspace_repository_credential -> status active, revision 1, validatedAt set
```
